$comment: Machine-readable companion to brand/design.md. scripts/build-brand.mjs generates every source SVG from colour, contrast, geometry.grid, geometry.symbol, geometry.lockup, the two symbol ratios under geometry.appIcon, concept.descriptor and the brand version and status, so a change to one of those is a change everywhere. Every other key (clear space, minimum sizes, favicon proportions, typography roles, render, forbidden, concept.tagline) is reference the generator does not read, and editing it changes no asset. The lettering on the social cards comes from scripts/brand/type.json. Edit values, run `pnpm brand:build`, review the diff.

brand.name: Conduit
brand.product: Cross-chain delivery versus payment for verified assets
brand.statusNote: Approved by the owner on 2026-10-05, when they asked for the identity to be wired into the product. The constants below are now the lock record, and every asset is marked approved in manifest.json.

concept.loadBearingIdea: Two assets stay where they are. One decision crosses, and it cannot be taken back.
concept.territory: Emotional outcome: two independent forms resolved at a single point
concept.mechanism: Two equal modules touch at one corner. A circular socket is cut from that corner and holds the point, which touches neither module. The mark is unchanged by a 180 degree turn about the point.

meaning.modules: the two parties and the two assets, equal and separate
meaning.point: the commit decision, the only chromatic value in the system
meaning.socket: the decision belongs to neither party, and Conduit holds no key that can move value

concept.descriptor: Cross-chain delivery versus payment for verified assets.

paper.role: page surface, and modules and text on ink

ember.role: the point. The only chromatic value in brand graphics. At most one red point in the content of a page, and lockups in page chrome (header, sidebar, footer) do not count. In the interface it also marks errors and destructive actions, as text, icon strokes and a 6 px dot. Never a surface fill

typography.mono: ui-monospace stack, as in the product
typography.fallback: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

wordmark.treatment: the tittle of the i is a rounded square, a miniature of a module

grid.note: 16u by 16u. Every symbol coordinate is a whole number of units.

horizontal.alignment: symbol centre on the cap-height midline

minimumSize.note: The symbol holds its geometry down to 16 px because every coordinate is a whole pixel at 16, 32, 48 and 64. No separate micro mark is needed.

render.approvedObject: two modules joined by a black cable and a black connector with one red status light: a clear acrylic top on a white base, and a brushed steel top on a white base
render.light: soft studio, high and slightly left
render.provenance: apps/web/assets/hero-source.png is reused as is. How it was produced is not recorded in the repository.

forbidden: bridges, arches, tunnels, portals, vortices or any form that implies an asset travelling between chains
swap arrows, double arrows, chain links, hexagons, cubes, node networks, coins
atoms, orbits or the word atomic: the protocol does not claim simultaneous execution
gradients, glow, glass, blur, aurora, neon, dark-tech styling
warm cream or amber backgrounds, and any chromatic value other than ember
more than one ember point in the content of a page, ember as a surface fill, or ember on a state that is not an error
recolouring the modules, rotating the mark, separating the point from the modules, adding outlines or shadows
all-caps or widely tracked lettering to signal authority
